**Lamina 0.4.2 is out!** 🎉

This one is about waiting less. Measured on eight examples, a slice is 23 % shorter on average, and a change to the sheets is 59 % shorter.

**New parts show in 3D sooner.** After a change, the 3D view shows the new parts while the sheets are still laid out. Progress moves to a strip under the view.

**Sheet settings answer faster.** Change the gap between parts, the labels or the sheet size, and Lamina only lays the sheets out again.

**Heavy models slice faster.** The bunny went from 27 s to 16 s. Parts and sheets stay the same.

**The browser version starts sooner.** A first visit waits about ten seconds less before the first slice.

**Guides in three kinds.** *Start here*, *Machines*, and a guide for each technique. Each guide shows what every setting changes, on one model.

Fixed too: each part is one group in the sheets PDF (thanks Colin), and the site tries a slice again when its engine fails.

Everything new, with a picture for each: *help* → *What is new*.
The guides: <https://marcelfarres.github.io/lamina/?ref=discord-0.4.2#guides>

Try it: <https://marcelfarres.github.io/lamina/app/?ref=discord-0.4.2>
